lines.en: I fly over the woods on buzzing wings.
My wings buzz loudly.
I skim over the treetops.
I circle through the jungle.
I hover, then move on.
I fly your way.
My body is heavy and my flight slow.
I thread beneath the canopy.
I descend one block slowly.
I bank around the tree trunk.
I come nearer bit by bit.
I stop midair and turn.
I fly over at an angle.
I shake my wings and fly on.
I hover with a buzzing hum.
My mandibles hang open in front.
I wait for a scent to spread.
I fan my wings slowly.
My abdomen hangs heavy.

lines.zh: 我在树杈上停了一会儿。
lines.en: I rest on a branch a while.
My eyes are big and round.
I tuck my legs under my belly.
I watch the movement below.
I hold still; only my wings move.
My wings catch the light.
I comb my antennae with my forelegs.

lines.zh: 我把头转向下面的声音。
lines.en: I turn my head to the sound below.
I hover and think it over.
I hover at your level.
My compound eyes face you.
I turn my head to look at you.
My mandibles open slowly.
I fly one block closer.
I have not blinked at all.
My wing pitch changes.
I am looking for a gap in you.
I dip toward you.
I drift slowly backward.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子给你看个全。
lines.en: I turn sideways so you see all of me.
I circle right above your head.
I face you without stirring.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在你肩膀上。
lines.en: My shadow settles on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的侧脸飘过去。
lines.en: I drift past the side of your face.
I fly a little lower toward you.
I shudder and fly crooked.
I am knocked off level.

lines.zh: 我被打得往上抬了两格。
lines.en: The hit pushes me two blocks higher.
My legs curl in.
I give a burst of buzzing.

lines.zh: 我摆了几下才找回平衡。
lines.en: A few lurches and I find my balance.

lines.zh: 我打着转才把身子正过来。
lines.en: I spin half around before righting myself.
My mandibles close.
I stare and my wings speed up.
I retreat behind a branch.
I catch a faint sweetness.
I fly over and circle once.

lines.zh: 我用前足把它拨了个圈。
lines.en: My forelegs roll it in a circle.
I bite once; it is cloying.
I eat none of this stuff.
I would rather eat insects.
I let go with my legs and drop it.
I fly back toward you.
I glance once and turn away.
I land on it for a moment.
I circle it halfway.
I hold it under my feet.
One touch from you and I tip sideways.
My wings smack across your face.
I shift half a block.
I brush past your shoulder.
My legs catch your sleeve.
I steady my altitude.
You step back; I stay.
The impact makes a buzzing knock.
My wingbeat goes ragged.
I rise two blocks.
Two giant bees meet in the air.
We fly one circle.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀声和我的合上。
lines.en: Its hum joins mine.
We settle on a branch together.
I touch its antenna.
We hover side by side.
Their legs touch.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝同一朵花去。
lines.en: We head for the same flower.
Neither of us makes a call.
We rise above the canopy together.

lines.zh: 我六条腿一起把它抱住。
lines.en: All six legs clamp around it.
I lift it and fly.
It is too heavy for me.
I drop it on a branch.

lines.zh: 我抱着它飞了半棵树远。
lines.en: I carry it half a tree's length.
I look and let go.
I press it under a leaf.
I sink with it in my grip.
I hover holding it.
I drop it into a tree hollow.
I stop and turn to you.

lines.zh: 翅膀的嗡嗡声一下子拔高。
lines.en: The hum of my wings jumps an octave.
I press my body down.
My mandibles spread wide.
I quit circling and come straight at you.
I have picked my angle.
I stop flying in circles.
My abdomen comes up.
You cannot outfly me here.
I halt above you.
My legs draw up.
I begin accelerating into a dive.
I fly after you.
Wherever you run, I am above.
I follow along the canopy.
I am not fast, and I will not stop.
You hide in the trees; I fly through.

lines.zh: 你头顶的影子就是我的。
lines.en: The shadow over your head is mine.
I lower my altitude bit by bit.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我已经换了位置。
lines.en: You look up and I have moved.
I come around the trunk.
Only three blocks between us.
I fly ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你退到树下，我停在枝上。
lines.en: You back under a tree; I perch.
I dive down and slam into you.
My mandibles clamp your shoulder.
I jab with my abdomen.
My legs catch your back.

lines.zh: 我一头撞得你脚步不稳。
lines.en: My charge knocks you off balance.
I strike and rise.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀拍得你站不稳。
lines.en: My wings beat you off balance.
I buzz as I hit.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的腿，我又飞起。
lines.en: You grab my leg and I lift off.
I come in again from the side.
My mandibles snap on air.
I sweep past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 林子里多了一阵嗡嗡声。
lines.en: A buzzing sound enters the woods.
I fly out from within the canopy.
A giant bee hovers ahead of you.
I begin flying through the jungle.
The leaves shake with my wingbeat.
My shadow sweeps the ground.
I come down from high up.
You hear wings vibrating.
I settle on this branch.
I begin circling this area.
My mandibles show between the leaves.
A sweet smell drifts in.
I begin circling at this level.
My wings bend the grass.

lines.zh: 火苗烧到我的翅膀，我立刻升高。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing and I climb at once.

lines.zh: 我从高空掉下，摔在落叶上。
lines.en: I drop from high up into the leaves.
Soaked wings and down I drop.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的身体翻了过来。
lines.en: The blast flips me over in the air.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿了我的一片翅膀。
lines.en: An arrow pierces one of my wings.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的悬停按住了。
lines.en: That force pins my hover.
Hunger makes my flight wobble.
Lightning strikes and my wings lock.

lines.zh: 下面的树没了，我一直坠。
lines.en: The trees below are gone; I fall.
